name: Fixture Scheme Experimental
description: A tier fixture: an Experimental color scheme, high-chroma magenta and cyan on near-white and near-black, for the quality gates to run as a shipping Experimental pack. Its accessible minimums are the same as a Stable pack.

provenance.attribution: Keyur Golani, for the keyurgolani.name portfolio platform.
provenance.derivation: anchor-v2 from high-chroma magenta and cyan anchors in light and dark. The anchors stay as approved. adjustments lists the 9 roles it moves from anchor-v1.

fallbacks: High contrast renders the sets high-contrast-v2 derives from each base set, and print renders the light set.
caveats: A test fixture: it registers only when QUALITY_FIXTURES is 1 or meta.
